# Native diagonal cell-centre ownership

Four fresh Sonnet18.53 Lite `OPTIONS -j` captures retain the actual rectangular
subsection supports for X/Y negative-direction zero-offset literals at targets
.0625 and.125. Full native matrices match the original non-current-export runs
bit for bit. Inputs, current SID files, full S matrices, stdout/stderr and
metadata are preserved exactly. Historical source hashes identify the original
captures; `sha256.toml` covers the portable payloads and this readme.

At .0625, the horizontal public ray misses two native cells in X, including an
undriven east-wall contact. In Y it adds one spurious north-wall cell. The
independent support comparisons retain those exact differences; .125 supports
match already. The extracted old raster method has exact source byte offsets
and whole-file/block hashes at commit3c9a5190.

The X causal control adds only the two observed cells. Its full-S error remains
approximately1.0 until the actual PEC wall contact is also restored, when it
falls to3.3974e-5. A retained inclusive-diagonal prototype repairs X but fails
Y; it is rejected. The vertical-ray half-open prototype matches both support
rules and passes all eight original .005 full-S/1e-9 voltage-residual gates.
It does not replace either failed physical baseline.

The maintained regressions execute the old method, compare actual masks to
independent native support, use an exact rational vertical-ray oracle, preserve
axis-aligned half-open ownership and connection flags, and check zero warmed
Julia allocation. The zero-offset physical regression now checks all eight
coupons; its original fixture/readme remains historical evidence of the prior
six-PASS/two-FAIL adapter scope. Native mesh/continuum acceptance outside these
controls remains separate work.
